# Runtime contract

This is a dependency-free static ESM handoff. Run `python serve.py`, then open `http://127.0.0.1:8765/`. No installation or credentials are needed. The root host is functional infrastructure only; every artist owns its own visual markup and stylesheet.

## Group entry point

`groups/<slug>/index.js` exports:

```js
export const artist = {
  slug: 'example', id: null, name: 'Example', nameZh: '',
  members: [], works: [], timeline: []
};
export function render({ route, helpers }) { return '<section>…</section>'; }
export function afterRender({ root, route, helpers }) { return () => {}; } // optional
```

`styles.css` must scope every ordinary selector to `[data-artist="<slug>"]`. Font-family and animation names must also be artist-specific. Group rendering must be independent, not a shared visual template with exchanged colors.

Member fields: `id: string|null`, `candidateKey?: string`, `name`, `nameZh`, `image?`. Work fields: `id: string|null`, `candidateKey?`, `title`, `type: 'release'|'mv'|'stage'`, `date?`, `dateKind?`, `videoId?`, `image?`. Timeline fields: `id: string|null`, `candidateKey?`, `title`, `date?`, `precision?: 'day'|'month'|'year'`, `sources?`. Preserve all additional original fields and production IDs. Never fill absent production IDs with a guessed value: use a separately named candidateKey.

`route = {slug, page, key, query}`. Pages are `home`, `members`, `member`, `works`, `work`, `timeline`; `query` is URLSearchParams. Detail key is `helpers.entityKey(entity)` (`id` first, otherwise candidateKey). Missing detail entities should show a navigable not-found state, never the first member/work as a substitute.

## Helpers

- `escape(value)` escapes HTML text and attributes.
- `href(slug, page='home', key=null, query={})` returns a hash URL. Query can be URLSearchParams or a plain object.
- `entityKey(entity)` returns its exact id/candidateKey, or null.
- `image(asset, alt, options={})` returns accessible image markup. Asset is a source string or object `{src|path|url,width?,height?,credit?,sha256?}`. Options: `className`, `loading` ('lazy' default; use 'eager' for hero), `fit` ('cover' default), `position` ('50% 50%' default), `caption` (false default). This function never alters, enlarges, crops, downloads or replaces original bytes; visual object-fit is documented display treatment.
- `filterWorks(works,{query='',type='all'})` filters without mutating input. No automatic type merging; release/MV/stage stay distinct.
- `sortTimeline(events)` returns a new oldest-first array. Valid YYYY, YYYY-MM and YYYY-MM-DD are supported; unknown/invalid dates remain last in original order. Ties preserve input order. A year/month is not rewritten to a fictitious precise day.
- `dateLabel(date,precision?)` formats only valid known precision, or returns an empty string.
- `sources(items)` renders real HTTP(S) source links. Strings or `{url,label|title}` are accepted. No link is invented.
- `videoHref(videoId)` returns the exact YouTube watch URL for a valid existing ID, or null. This helper does not fetch or verify the video.

No user record/score/watch-state writes, localStorage or new persistence are provided. Group interactions can use DOM state and hash queries. The host retains same-group navigation and restores focused link position when possible after browser Back. Source drawers should use native details/summary unless a group needs a distinct documented interaction. The timeline must be a single read-only sequence, oldest first.

`shared/host.css` is the standalone preview host only. Do not import it into the production site globally. Its minimal resets are restricted to the preview mount or host body; production integration should mount one artist module under its matching data-artist scope and use the existing site's approved utility/reset rules. Unload the previous group stylesheet when switching artists, as app.js does.

## Runtime boundary

Shared files are owned by runtime QA. Group owners edit only assigned `groups/<slug>/` folders. Root owns source restoration, references, batches and Library persistence. Running `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` verifies the functional layer. `node tests/audit-groups.mjs` checks every currently present module and renders every member/work route; it reports absent groups honestly and is not a browser visual acceptance test.

Additional reproducible checks:

```sh
node tests/audit-baseline.mjs
node tests/audit-stage-bindings.mjs
python tests/audit-assets.py
node tests/audit-structure.mjs
python tests/http-smoke.py
```

Each audit accepts `--groups=slug1,slug2` and `--out=<report path>`. The baseline audit needs the public input projection shipped with a batch (`inputs/` or `qa/fixtures/`); it excludes explicitly declared dummy work IDs and verifies existing production member/work identities. Asset audit decodes and hashes declared local display files without fetching or modifying them. Structure comparison reports source-level differences only. HTTP smoke starts an ephemeral same-process localhost server and checks exact served bytes; it does not execute browser JavaScript or prove layout. None of these checks substitute for browser screenshots, viewport/zoom inspection, Figma import, or visual review.

The separate selected-stage audit requires the exact per-target `existingStageSources` projection. It matches `parentWorkId`/`workId`/`sourceWorkId` plus exact `videoId`, catches omitted or mismatched selected pairs and duplicate cards, and does not mistake an extra SBS or other platform performance for a YouTube source. If multiple existing public work versions select the same performance, one deduplicated stage card may retain those exact IDs in `parentWorkIds`; this is a local projection of existing public bindings, not a newly created production relation. Research/candidate keys alone are not parent-work evidence.


## Reconciled mount and action boundary

Import `mountArtist`, `destroyArtist` from `shared/lifecycle.js`. Call `mountArtist({root,module,route,helpers,onActivation,onIdentityError})`; await `handle.ready`, and call `handle.destroy()` or `destroyArtist(root)` before removing the mount. Mounting again on the same root destroys its previous scope. `afterRender` receives a scope for owned listeners, timeouts, intervals, animation frames, async commit guards, dialog and element cleanup; legacy returned cleanup functions are still supported.

Actual DOM IDs are prefixed per mount and original local IDs are retained as data-local-id; labels and ARIA references are rewritten together. Ordinary fragment focus/scroll stays within the current hash route. All group styles remain scoped to their artist; the host stylesheet is preview-only. No font/keyframe alias is shared across artists.

The adapter validates activation identity before existing click/submit/change handlers. `onActivation` receives the event, element and identity. Identity includes groupId/slug, entity type and real ID or separate candidateKey, exact work/video and parentWorkIds, original eventId and related source member/work IDs, exact source URL/IDs, target URL, full return route and repeated query entries. Unknown IDs, another group's target, altered source-ID/URL pairs and a different YouTube video are rejected. This is an integration callback, not a score/watch-state write or a new persistence system.

The Node harness verifies native EventTarget dispatch and adapter contracts without a browser DOM. It does not prove browser click propagation, focus, keyboard, dialog or visual behavior; those remain pending in the reported environment.

# Billlie 接码增量

以 `libfile_9a234de2f1f88191abc850d4c4735e7f` 的Billlie已交付设计为基准，复用 `libfile_3a3ce7a6d8f8819189f504bcb11ff2b3` 已核成员照和发行封面。实际查看原390首页。保持深黑底、酒红成员段落、淡紫排字、衬线专辑标题与开放章节构图；成员详情、作品库及单轴时间轴各按用途重排，不使用NewJeans或i-dle视觉骨架。

新增完整可运行静态ESM：首页、七人成员目录及全部个人详情、作品库、15发行详情、13MV与13舞台详情、唯一最早优先只读时间轴，共41项作品/52条渲染路径。成员全部默认可见，姓名按已有稳定ID映射。48图通过已记录SHA1精确找到既有本地文件，再测SHA256与尺寸并完整解码；没有重新下载、转码或放大。

15项发行仍是候选键，projectReleaseId全部保留空值；13个真实MV workId保留，舞台使用workId＋准确videoId候选键，不制造生产记录。MV与舞台分层，不跨视频借图。发行日期不改标为MV日期；舞台日期按既有视频公开字段。17件团体事件保留，其中两条未提供精确日期的成员活动公告不编造日期、排序位于已知日期之后。前台不重复显示内部“未详”审核句。

1440、390、320及宽屏CSS已实现：桌面唱片与叙述左右分区、四列成员、手机二列七人完整显示；个人页摄影优先，作品库发行/MV/舞台筛选独立，时间轴手机日期与标题垂直重排，四项导航320仍各有触达区域。1800以上容器1536。浏览器布局、2048/2560及80/100/125%缩放、真实点击返回仍未验收。未运行Figma，不把本地代码说成本轮Figma完成。

已执行：Node语法检查、全部52条路径静态渲染、公开基线13个MV和7位成员ID/版本无缺失检查、48张图片SHA与完整解码。现有图片全覆盖本包41项作品，但这只是已交付设计和公共快照范围，不宣称当前完整官方唱片目录已重新审读。

本轮Spotify200；Mystic韩国官网503后停止，不换接口重试。素材身份沿用原包具名官网证据，旧包有效Figma上下文和截图只引用不重新导出。真实Figma定位见design-reference.json。dot接回原有评分、搜索导航保护和网站模块，本包不改已发布网站或私人记录。

# billlie · 公开内容恢复增量 v2

沿用上一版独立布局和素材。本增量只恢复公开数据与实际页面呈现、修正作品返回及版本入口，不重新采图、不写生产或私人状态。

| 恢复范围 | 实际数量 |
|---|---:|
| 成员完整公开行与个人履历 | 7 |
| 原始成员经历段 | 7 |
| 原始 ready 事件 | 17 |
| 单根从远到近日期轴 | 14 |
| 轴外可读无日期公告 | 3 |
| 原有 MV—舞台真实父作品对 | 13 |

`reconciliation.js` 接入原始公开输入，`shared/reconcile.js` 由根项目维护。成员 `publicBaseline`、`careerPeriods`、`careerSources` 与事件 `canonicalEvent` 原样保留；原版成员与时间轴保存在 `previousPublicMember`、`previousTimeline`。本团 `sourceTimeline`、`sourceTimelineGaps` 保留完整原始记录及内部缺口。确切事件ID及日期对应见 `event-preservation-map.json`。

个人页实际展示个人正文、公开角色、公开状态、历史成员语义和每段经历的来源。空结束日期不擅自解释为“至今”；经历公告日、生效日及原始事件标签分别显示。

时间轴主排序取原始事件日，缺事件日才取公告日，绝不使用计划日代替。未定日期公告保留在轴外可读区。`public-copy.js` 只提供前台简短正文，不覆盖原始 `summary`；页面不展示内部复核话术。公告与计划日期、月精度保留区分。

作品筛选进入详情及显式返回保留本团完整 URLSearchParams，含未知字段与重复参数；不新增保存系统。`video-relations.js` 仅允许 MV 与舞台通过已知生产 `rec…` 父作品ID精确关联：MV `id/workId` 对应舞台 `parentWorkId/workId/sourceWorkId/parentWorkIds`。空值、候选键、同名、日期、videoId、舞台自身实体ID及发行记录均不能推断版本关系；原始作品与视频绑定未改。

验证命令：在源码根运行 `node --test groups/billlie/reconciliation.test.mjs`。2026-10-20实际执行28项，28通过、0失败、0跳过；覆盖三团独立原始输入深比较、全部个人页履历与来源渲染、40条原始ready事件及5条无日期公告、筛选/详情/返回与submit处理器、24个既有视频对及无绑定负例。测试中的合成无绑定记录仅在进程内临时加入并finally移除，不落入素材或生产数据。

数据与 assets 文件逐字节对比上一版结果见 Billlie 目录 `reconciliation-validation.json`。本轮没有浏览器点击、1440/390/320实际视觉、宽屏或缩放验收，也没有Figma落地验收；Node渲染与处理器测试不能替代这些检查。原包尚存的视频配图、候选发行ID等素材缺项继续沿用，不新增推定关系。dot负责生产接入与最终审核。

# wooah · 独立页面 v1

黑色时装校样、紧窄粗字、洋红边框与大幅真实摄影；不延续旧稿虚构电台。

首页大字与照片相接、左右成员纵向清单/发行墙；成员目录用编号+中文名+小幅肖像的横行；人物详情巨幅罗马名与写真；作品三列分层；单轴左侧大日期。

## 接入

入口 `index.js` 导出 artist/render/afterRender；视觉样式仅作用于 `[data-artist="wooah"]`。`data.js` 为公开输入的只读设计投影；`data.json` 提供机器可读映射。复用根目录已有路由、图片恢复及返回焦点契约，不复制评分、备注、观看或保存系统。dot 将这个表现层接入真实 loader，不能用演示投影覆盖生产数据。

全部真实既有成员、作品 ID 保留。Spotify 新观察到的发行使用 `id:null` 与独立 candidateKey，`projectReleaseId:null`；仅是观察到的平台目录投影，不是全部正式发行、不创建生产记录。已有舞台来源按独立 candidateKey 完整保留，id:null、parentWorkId 与 videoId 精确映射，不把舞台另建成生产记录。发行封面不冒充某支 MV 截帧；缺少可核对应图的 MV 保留为纯排版索引及准确官方视频入口。

## 页面与交互

首页、成员目录、全部成员详情、作品库、全部作品详情、时间轴都有独立可导航路由。成员默认全部可见，历史成员单独标注，不把团体照片人数当全历史阵容。作品搜索和发行/MV/舞台筛选写入 URL，不写用户记录；无结果、无效成员/作品均有返回入口。时间轴只有时间轴页的一根只读序列，最早优先；仅采用另行取得的音乐平台发行事件，旧MV日期逐条语义未核不冒称发布事件。首页只有入口，不制造第二根年表。来源使用可展开 details；外部视频不伪装为已播放。

## 响应式

1440 为主要桌面构图；390/320 在 760px 断点下重排，导航保留四项可见，不用挤压长标签。中文长名自然换行，不截断姓名、作品标题或日期；320 不缩小正文到不可读尺寸。2048/2560 使用 max-width 容器与外侧留白。80/100/125% 缩放及键盘/图片失败的实际浏览器视觉检查仍待执行，不能以静态规则代替。prefers-reduced-motion 已明确禁用非必要动态。

## 图片与证据

真实文件、原始字节、尺寸、SHA-256、来源和身份绑定见 asset-map.json。已有合格文件从恢复包复制，未重新采集；新增必要肖像仅使用逐人具名官方/媒体照片，没有开展 MV 同造型照片工程。保留水印；图片全图 contain，连同水印完整展示；不重编码、裁切或放大原文件。小尺寸平台封面标明实际尺寸，详情使用 contain。资料照拍摄时间未提供的，不宣称是当前拍摄。

正常访问取得的 HTML/图片及位置记录在 reference-index.json。官网无法完整渲染和仅有图片观察的部分明确保留为未验；概念图中的虚构日期、英文名、封面和照片均未进入数据或网页。概念图片不作为可用页面或验收截图。

## 验证边界

已执行源码语法与所有已知实体路由渲染、精确公共基线 ID 完整性、图片字节 SHA 与实际解码；经非作者发现并修复旧日期误作MV发布及WOOYEON横图裁脸/裁水印问题。最终结果由根目录 QA 文件汇总。未做实际浏览器视口/缩放/键盘视觉验收，未调用 Figma，未完成原生落地、艺术审核或生产接入。剩余事项见 gaps.json；dot 最终视觉审核与发布。


## 2026-10-20 内容与关系恢复增量

不改原独立视觉、图片字节或作品绑定。`index.js` 通过 `reconcileArtist(data,reconciliation)` 恢复完整公开字段、成员时期/来源与成熟时间轴；`data.js/data.json` 保留为v1输入，不能把旧投影覆盖当前对象。成员页展示个人正文、关系与按资料原意标注的经历日期，公告与独立生效日期分开。

时间轴使用原有ready事件ID、标题、摘要、来源与精度；事件日、公告、计划、生效含义分别列出，不以日期已过推计划完成。作品/MV、CD、音源与直播安排不互相替代。旧候选→原事件映射、继承缺项已解决情况及来源冲突见 reconciliation-notes.json；原始源行保留，未擅改事实。

筛选→详情→返回保留完整同团查询，搜索只修改q/type；真实成员/作品/事件上下文属性供根层身份守卫定位。实际Node检查通过，仍未执行浏览器/Figma验收；不发布。WOOAH SORA原公开输入只有安全节选，完整生产个人正文尚不可验证，已保留现有非空资料及原字段标志，不宣称全量原文恢复。
